notes: Which dungeons: every WoW Forever dungeon whose recommended range starts above level 50 (levels from zockify.com's Forever dungeon list).
Left out: Alcaz Prison (48-53), Maraudon (46-55), Zul'Farrak (44-54), Uldaman (42-52) and Krol'dok Stronghold (40-55) start below 50.
Loot: wowtbc.gg WoW Forever loot tables. The site says loot is still being discovered and original-dungeon drops come from Classic Era tables and may have moved.
Boss order: original dungeons follow the usual route through the instance. For Blackmaw Hold and Shaper's Terrace the order follows the loot site, because no official boss order has been published.

Boss type: Rare = may not spawn every run; Summoned = needs an item or quest to call; Event = only during a world event; Ring of Law = one of these is chosen at random; Tribute chest = Dire Maul North tribute run.
Shaper's Terrace: the site lists 'Vitrix' with the combined drops of Bolt, Cinder and Snowtalon. It is kept as listed.
Drop chance is only filled in where the source showed one. Quest rewards are not included.
Stratholme: the site lists both sides together; bosses are split into Live and Undead using the standard layout.
